source_facts: Index Administrator cannot make discretionary decisions.
Selection is based on the Index Universe.
Initial composition and ordinary rebalance selection are determined on the Selection Day.
Each security is classified into Americas or Europe.
Canada or United States maps to Americas.
Europe country assignment maps to Europe.
Securities are ranked descending by Free Float Market Cap.
Top 20 securities per region are selected for inclusion.
Fewer than 20 eligible securities in a region yields fewer than 40 components total.
render_facts: Selection of index components is fully rule-based.
Eligible securities are drawn from the index universe.
Securities with Canada or United States assignment are classified to the Americas region.
Securities with Europe assignment are classified to the Europe Region.
Within each region, eligible securities are ranked in descending order by free-float market capitalization.
Securities selected for index inclusion are the eligible securities ranked 20 or better in their region.
No more than 20 securities may be selected in any region.
Index components, the initial composition, and the ordinary rebalance selection are determined by the securities selected for index inclusion.
If any region has fewer than 20 eligible securities, the number of index components is less than 40.
The Index Administrator may not make a discretionary decision in relation to the selection.

render_only_facts.fact: No more than 20 securities may be selected in any region.
